# DumbJ keymap

<!-- Generated from keymaps/ by dumbj-actions. Do not edit by hand. -->

Linux uses the `macOS For All` keymap and macOS uses IntelliJ's `Mac OS X 10.5+` keymap.

| Action | DumbJ ID | IntelliJ ID | Linux | macOS |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Folder… | `project.open-folder` | `OpenFile` | — | — |
| Close Tab | `tabs.close` | `CloseContent` | `Ctrl+W` | `⌘W` |
| Select Next Tab | `tabs.next` | `NextTab` | `Ctrl+Shift+]` | `⇧⌘]` / `⌃Right` |
| Select Previous Tab | `tabs.previous` | `PreviousTab` | `Ctrl+Shift+[` | `⇧⌘[` / `⌃Left` |
| Project Tool Window | `tool-window.project` | `ActivateProjectToolWindow` | `Alt+1` | `⌘1` |
| Hide All Tool Windows | `tool-window.hide-all` | `HideAllWindows` | `Ctrl+Shift+F12` | `⇧⌘F12` |
| Go to Line:Column… | `editor.goto-line` | `GotoLine` | `Ctrl+L` | `⌘L` |
| Find… | `editor.find` | `Find` | `Ctrl+F` | `⌘F` |
| Find Next | `editor.find-next` | `FindNext` | `Ctrl+G` | `⌘G` |
| Find Previous | `editor.find-previous` | `FindPrevious` | `Alt+Shift+G` | `⇧⌘G` |
| Extend Selection | `editor.extend-selection` | `EditorSelectWord` | `Alt+Up` | `⌥Up` |
| Go to Declaration | `navigate.goto-declaration` | `GotoDeclaration` | `Ctrl+B` / `Ctrl+Click` | `⌘B` / `⌘Click` / `Middle Click` |
| Back | `navigate.back` | `Back` | `Ctrl+Alt+Left` / `Ctrl+[` / `Mouse Back` | `⌘[` / `⌥⌘Left` / `Mouse Back` |
| Forward | `navigate.forward` | `Forward` | `Ctrl+Alt+Right` / `Ctrl+]` / `Mouse Forward` | `⌘]` / `⌥⌘Right` / `Mouse Forward` |
| Search Everywhere | `navigate.search-everywhere` | `SearchEverywhere` | `Shift Shift` | `Shift Shift` |
| Go to Class… | `navigate.goto-class` | `GotoClass` | `Ctrl+O` | `⌘O` |
| Go to File… | `navigate.goto-file` | `GotoFile` | `Ctrl+Shift+O` | `⇧⌘O` |
| Go to Symbol… | `navigate.goto-symbol` | `GotoSymbol` | `Ctrl+Alt+O` | `⌥⌘O` |
| File Structure | `navigate.file-structure` | `FileStructurePopup` | `Ctrl+F12` | `⌘F12` |
| Move Caret Left | `text.move-left` | `EditorLeft` | `Left` | `Left` / `⌃B` |
| Move Caret Right | `text.move-right` | `EditorRight` | `Right` | `Right` / `⌃F` |
| Move Caret Up | `text.move-up` | `EditorUp` | `Up` | `Up` / `⌃P` |
| Move Caret Down | `text.move-down` | `EditorDown` | `Down` | `Down` / `⌃N` |
| Move Caret to Line Start | `text.move-line-start` | `EditorLineStart` | `Home` / `Ctrl+Left` | `⌘Left` / `⌃A` / `Home` |
| Move Caret to Line End | `text.move-line-end` | `EditorLineEnd` | `End` / `Ctrl+Right` | `⌘Right` / `⌃E` / `End` |
| Move Caret to Text Start | `text.move-text-start` | `EditorTextStart` | `Ctrl+Home` | `⌘Home` |
| Move Caret to Text End | `text.move-text-end` | `EditorTextEnd` | `Ctrl+End` | `⌘End` |
| Move Caret Page Up | `text.move-page-up` | `EditorPageUp` | `PgUp` | `PgUp` |
| Move Caret Page Down | `text.move-page-down` | `EditorPageDown` | `PgDn` | `PgDn` |
| Move Caret to Previous Word | `text.move-word-left` | `EditorPreviousWord` | `Alt+Left` | `⌥Left` / `⌃⌥B` |
| Move Caret to Next Word | `text.move-word-right` | `EditorNextWord` | `Alt+Right` | `⌥Right` / `⌃⌥F` |
| Move Caret Left with Selection | `text.select-left` | `EditorLeftWithSelection` | `Shift+Left` | `⇧Left` |
| Move Caret Right with Selection | `text.select-right` | `EditorRightWithSelection` | `Shift+Right` | `⇧Right` |
| Move Caret Up with Selection | `text.select-up` | `EditorUpWithSelection` | `Shift+Up` | `⇧Up` |
| Move Caret Down with Selection | `text.select-down` | `EditorDownWithSelection` | `Shift+Down` | `⇧Down` |
| Move Caret to Line Start with Selection | `text.select-line-start` | `EditorLineStartWithSelection` | `Shift+Home` / `Ctrl+Shift+Left` | `⇧⌘Left` / `⇧Home` |
| Move Caret to Line End with Selection | `text.select-line-end` | `EditorLineEndWithSelection` | `Shift+End` / `Ctrl+Shift+Right` | `⇧⌘Right` / `⇧End` |
| Move Caret to Text Start with Selection | `text.select-text-start` | `EditorTextStartWithSelection` | `Ctrl+Shift+Home` | `⇧⌘Home` |
| Move Caret to Text End with Selection | `text.select-text-end` | `EditorTextEndWithSelection` | `Ctrl+Shift+End` | `⇧⌘End` |
| Move Caret Page Up with Selection | `text.select-page-up` | `EditorPageUpWithSelection` | `Shift+PgUp` | `⇧PgUp` |
| Move Caret Page Down with Selection | `text.select-page-down` | `EditorPageDownWithSelection` | `Shift+PgDn` | `⇧PgDn` |
| Move Caret to Previous Word with Selection | `text.select-word-left` | `EditorPreviousWordWithSelection` | `Alt+Shift+Left` | `⌥⇧Left` / `⌃⌥⇧B` |
| Move Caret to Next Word with Selection | `text.select-word-right` | `EditorNextWordWithSelection` | `Alt+Shift+Right` | `⌥⇧Right` / `⌃⌥⇧F` |
| Select All | `text.select-all` | `$SelectAll` | `Ctrl+A` | `⌘A` |
| Copy | `text.copy` | `$Copy` | `Ctrl+C` / `Ctrl+Insert` | `⌘C` / `⌘Insert` |
| Cut | `text.cut` | `$Cut` | `Ctrl+X` / `Shift+Delete` | `⌘X` / `⇧Delete` |
| Paste | `text.paste` | `$Paste` | `Ctrl+V` / `Shift+Insert` | `⌘V` / `⇧Insert` |
| Backspace | `text.backspace` | `EditorBackSpace` | `Backspace` / `Shift+Backspace` | `Backspace` / `⇧Backspace` |
| Delete | `text.delete` | `EditorDelete` | `Delete` | `Delete` |
| Tab | `text.tab` | `EditorTab` | `Tab` | `Tab` |
| Enter | `text.enter` | `EditorEnter` | `Enter` | `Enter` |
| Escape | `text.escape` | `EditorEscape` | `Esc` | `Esc` |
